name: Montreal Comiccon
blurb: Quebec's major pop-culture convention in Montreal, with film, TV, anime and comics guests, artist alley, and the Cosplay-Eh! Canadian Cosplay Championship finale.

editions.evidence: Homepage hero text: '5 ET 6 DÉC. – ÉDITION DES FÊTES'; mtl.org's listing confirms 'December 5 and 6, 2026' at 'Palais des congrès de Montréal, 1001 Place Jean-Paul-Riopelle'.
Homepage hero text: 'LE COMICCON SERA DE RETOUR DU 2 AU 4 JUILLET 2027 PALAIS DES CONGRÈS', with hero image alt 'BILLETS EN VENTE SOUS PEU' (tickets not yet on sale).

notes: This brand runs two shows a year in Montreal under one site: a small December 'Édition des Fêtes' (holiday market with 225+ exhibitors, concerts, comedy and a masquerade, per mtl.org — no celebrity guests mentioned anywhere, so guests='none') and the main summer con, confirmed back for July 2-4 2027. The site's news feed (Christopher Lloyd, Tom Welling, Naruto/Spider-Man/Avatar voice actors, WWE wrestlers, Peacemaker/Friday the 13th cast, dated May-June 2026) was that past summer edition's lineup; the live 'Tous les invités' guest page (artistes/) now renders with zero guest cards ahead of the 2027 show, so that edition is guests='none-yet'. Organizer company name not confirmed from the rendered page (not pursued further to stay in budget); top nav also links sister Comiccon shows in Quebec City, Ottawa, Winnipeg and Laval plus a 'Festival Hobby', each its own convention/file. Used the most recent hero banner (mcc26_heros_web.png) as cover; the og:image is a stale 2018 share image.
